[[Funchal]] | capacity = 3,000 | pattern_la1 = _tigres1314h | pattern_b1 = _bluecollar | pattern_ra1 = tigres1314h | pattern_sh1 = _adidasgold | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_gold | leftarm1 = fecd37 | body1 = fecd37 | rightarm1 = fecd37 | shorts1 = 1937cd | socks1 = 1937cd | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _blueshoulders | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = FFD700 }} '''Clube de Futebol União''', commonly known as '''União''' '''da Madeira''', was a Portuguese [[association football|football club]] based in [[Funchal, Madeira]], notable for its six seasons in the Portuguese top-flight [[Primeira Liga]], between the [[1989–90 Primeira Divisão|1989–90]] and [[1991–92 Primeira Divisão|1991–92]] seasons, the [[1993–94 Primeira Divisão|1993–94]] and [[1994–95 Primeira Divisão|1994–95]] seasons{{citation needed|date=October 2025}} and most recently in the [[2015–16 Primeira Liga|2015–16]] season.{{citation needed|date=October 2025}} The club was originally founded on 1 November 1913, thus being one of the oldest football clubs in Portugal,{{cite news|url=http://www.uniaodamadeira.com/clube.asp|title=O Club|trans-title=The Club|work=uniaodamadeira.com|language=pt|date=19 July 2012|access-date=19 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111018072918/http://www.uniaodamadeira.com/clube.asp|archive-date=18 October 2011}} and maintained a strong local rivalry with neighbours [[C.S. Marítimo|Marítimo]] and [[C.D. Nacional|Nacional da Madeira]] throughout much of its history. After building mounting debts,{{cite news |url=https://www.dnoticias.pt/2021/12/16/289268-milhoes-de-euros-depois/#|title=''Milhões de euros depois''|work=Diário de Notícias Madeira|language=pt|access-date=31 December 2021}} and failing to fulfil consecutive matches leading to disqualification from competing in the [[Campeonato de Portugal (league)|Campeonato de Portugal]]{{cite news |url=https://www.abola.pt/nnh/2021-11-29/uniao-uniao-da-madeira-fora-do-campeonato-de-portugal/915583|title=''União da Madeira fora do Campeonato de Portugal''|work=[[A Bola]]|language=pt|access-date=31 December 2021}} – the country's fourth-tier league – União da Madeira were forcibly dissolved on 23 November 2021.{{cite news |url=https://www.dnoticias.pt/2021/11/23/286171-aprovada-dissolucao-e-encerramento-do-clube-futebol-uniao/|title=''Aprovada dissolução e encerramento do Clube Futebol União''|work=Diário de Notícias Madeira|language=pt|access-date=31 December 2021}} As a sports club, União da Madeira had sports departments for [[Basketball]], [[Fencing]], [[Association football|Football]], [[handball]], [[Roller hockey (Quad)|Roller Hockey]], [[Rugby football|Rugby]] and [[Volleyball]].{{cite news|url=http://www.cfuniao.pt.vu/|title=Modalidades|work=uniaodamadeira.com|language=pt|date=19 July 2012|access-date=19 July 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151130075157/http://www.cfuniao.pt.vu/|archive-date=30 November 2015|url-status=dead}}{{cite news |url=http://uniaorugby.blogspot.co.uk/ |title=CLUBE FUTEBOL UNIÃO RUGBY|work=uniaorugby.blogspot.co.uk/|language=pt| date=19 July 2012 |access-date=19 July 2012 }}{{cite news|url=http://www.idram.pt/demografia/DemFed0506.pdf|title=Instituto do Desporto da RAM|trans-title=Institute of Sport of RAM|work=idram.pt|language=pt|date=19 July 2012|access-date=19 July 2012|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070930030227/http://www.idram.pt/demografia/DemFed0506.pdf|archive-date=30 September 2007}} The professional football team were notably sponsored by the [[Museu CR7]], the local museum dedicated to [[Cristiano Ronaldo]], who was born in Funchal.{{cite news |url=https://jornaleconomico.sapo.pt/noticias/museu-cr7-patrocina-uniao-da-madeira-por-mais-uma-epoca-176366 |title=Museu CR7 patrocina União da Madeira por mais uma época|language=pt| date=27 June 2017 |access-date=15 January 2020 }} A new [[phoenix club (sports)|phoenix club]], [[União da Bola Futebol Clube]] was founded in 2022, with the aim of "honouring the legacy" of the demised club. The club entered a senior football team into the 1ª Divisão of the [[Madeira Football Association]].{{cite news|title="União da bola" está de volta|trans-title="União da Bola" is back |url=https://www.rtp.pt/madeira/desporto/uniao-da-bola-esta-de-volta_100958 |access-date=15 December 2022 |publisher=[[Rádio e Televisão de Portugal]] |date=30 August 2022 |language=pt}}"}}
